meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 渲染动画视频并生成配音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做动画短视频，需要批量渲染并加配音。
copy.tagline_en: Render animated videos and generate voiceover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly make animated short videos and need batch rendering with voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你完成 HyperFrames 项目从搭建到渲染成视频的流程,并诊断构建或渲染失败。支持本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda 与 Google Cloud Run 渲染。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或修改 HyperFrames 项目、诊断构建或渲染失败,或需要调用预览、渲染等命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 新建一个叫 demo 的项目
say.note: 会运行 npx hyperframes init demo

say.text: 在目录里搜一下有没有逐行揭示标题的效果
say.note: 会调用 catalog --query 查找现成动画部件

say.text: 用草稿质量把当前项目渲染成 out.mp4

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses npx hyperframes to take a HyperFrames project from scaffolding to rendered video and to diagnose build/render failures. Rendering works locally, on HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a HyperFrames project, diagnose build/render failures, or run commands like preview, render, and catalog search.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new HyperFrames project called demo.
Search the catalog for a line-by-line headline reveal.
Render the current project to out.mp4 at draft quality.
